description: This file contains internal tests for distributed features in PyTorch, including distributed communication, process groups, model averaging, barrier synchronization, and various backend-specific tests (NCCL, GLOO). It defines numerous test classes and utility functions to validate distributed operations, cover different scenarios, and ensure robustness of distributed execution.
